title: Holes & Stars — Move a two-opening pair without changing its gap
help: These pairs keep the same horizontal gap and source order. Moving both openings together turns every arriving arrow by a common phase; the ideal far-field brightness stays the same. The chosen sky spot and opening patches stay put. Undo restores the mask.
rows: The same pair shifted right and up
message: crosses experiments keep the supplied choices silent and reversible
facts: Model phase=−2π(u*x+v*y)+existing per-source phase. Translating both points adds the same phase; sum magnitude/intensity is invariant, including unequal source strength and envelope when unchanged.
